changes.problem: The original scope mentioned optional routed NPDUs while several response fields use absolute offsets.
changes.resolution: Make the reviewed package explicitly un-routed and fix NPDU control to the declared fixture; retain routed support as an unimplemented broader description requirement.

changes.problem: The state graph advertised an additional independent invoke although the host accepts one pending request.
changes.resolution: Remove pending-to-pending ReadProperty request edge and explicitly describe single-flight behavior.

changes.problem: I-Am Device object type and segmentation enum bounds were wider than the named service.
changes.resolution: Constrain Device ObjectIdentifier to object type 8 and segmentation to values 0..3; keep absolute-width limitations explicit.

changes.problem: Absolute response projections could be mistaken for a dynamic response grammar.
changes.resolution: Annotate every affected response and field as fixture-specific; do not invent semantic locators or claim routed/tag-width coverage.

codec_constraints.constraint: Un-routed NPDU control=0, APDU UnconfirmedRequest service 8; device limits are both absent or a valid ordered context-tag pair within 0..4194303.

Un-routed NPDU control=4, ConfirmedRequest service 12, fixed max-APDU header=5, dynamic context object/property and optional array index; request field generation retains the existing UInt8 property/index bound.

Un-routed ComplexACK service12 with current invoke correlation; the supplied apdu.content tree includes object/property/optional array plus opening/closing context3 value. The tree is descriptive; it is not a generic property-value executor.

Complete supplied I-Am fixture with application tags ObjectIdentifier/Unsigned/Enumerated/Unsigned; absolute field slices assume its tag widths. Device type8 and segmentation0..3 are model bounds; dynamic response tag positions are not implemented.
Complete supplied Error service12 fixture with matching invoke and two application ENUMERATED values; error_class/error_code absolute slices assume one value octet each.

Complete supplied un-routed Reject/server-Abort fixtures: invoke then one reason octet, no service-choice payload. Runtime correlation uses the current ReadProperty invoke; reason abs:8 is fixture-specific.
One pending request per session is enforced by the host. State guard/actions and structure_model remain annotations; they do not create a transaction table or run conditions.

remaining_gaps.description: Only the named seven-message service profile is described. Segmentation, BBMD/foreign-device lifecycle, BACnet/SC and other services remain absent.
remaining_gaps.resolution: Add versioned service models, real reference messages, matching parser/encoder capability and independent conformance checks before broadening the scope.

remaining_gaps.description: I-Am and Error application fields lack semantic response locators; their absolute slices cannot cover all legal tag widths. Routed responses are excluded by this reviewed NPDU constraint.
remaining_gaps.resolution: Implement typed tag-based I-Am/Error/reason locators in the C/Python mappings, add routed/tag-width variants and verify before removing the restriction.

remaining_gaps.description: ReadProperty property/index generation remains UInt8 and the runtime has one pending request; generic concurrent invoke handling and arbitrary property-value execution are absent.
remaining_gaps.resolution: Add width-aware scalar serialization and an explicit tested transaction model if those capabilities are required; retain the present restricted profile until then.

remaining_gaps.description: generic_wire.json contains only ReadProperty and one exact ACK; it omits Who-Is/I-Am/Error/Reject/Abort and cannot express dynamic NPDU/LVT/optional-field behavior.
remaining_gaps.resolution: Extend the generic language and loader for the needed structures and response alternatives; do not replace missing services with fixed opaque payload or flip online to true.

remaining_gaps.description: The reviewed YAML is a static candidate. No native compiler, runtime test or target was executed for this candidate.
remaining_gaps.resolution: Compile/validate this source pair into a new package, plan its corpus and preserve actual session evidence before release.
